summary: - **[key4hep/k4FWCore#447](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/447)** — OverlayTiming now adds the energy of background SimCalorimeterHit contributions to a hit they are merged into. Before this change, the merged hit's energy was not updated. Behaviour also changes: a signal or background calorimeter hit is kept whole, with all contributions and its full energy, if any of its contributions falls inside the time window, and per-contribution timing cuts are left to digitisation. Minimum EDM4hep and podio versions are bumped.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#172](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/172)** — The framework (k4run) input conversion now converts MCParticle times from ns to the mm/c that Delphes expects. Previously all production times in k4SimDelphesAlg were too small by a factor c. This corrupted particle times, track times at the vertex for non-prompt tracks, and calorimeter-level times for displaced particles, compared with the standalone executables.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#171](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/171)** — Fixes the RecoMCLink collection, which was always empty in the Gaudi-based k4SimDelphesAlg workflow because the gen-to-reco map was cleared before the links were built. Links are now created during conversion and can point to the external MCParticle collection on the event store.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#67](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/67)** — Fixes units across the generator interfaces: GaussSmearVertex time smearing was about 300 times too small and is now correct. HepEVTReader and MDIReader production times are converted from mm/c to ns. HepMC2/HepMC3 file readers now convert events to GeV and mm regardless of the units stored in the file.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#452](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/452)** — The Writer now deletes the store wrappers of collections registered through the legacy DataHandle/DataWrapper path. These wrappers previously leaked one per collection per event, about 1.8 kB/event in a Pythia8 + k4SimDelphesAlg IDEA job.

- **[AIDASoft/podio#1023](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1023)** — podio can now be built without ROOT, using SIO or Arrow backends only. This is controlled by a new ENABLE_ROOT CMake option and propagated downstream via PODIO_ENABLE_ROOT. ROOT remains the default, and the Python interfaces still require it.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#676](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/676)** — The ALLEGRO turbine ECAL endcap now places each wheel's unit cells in a dedicated mother volume. Time to first event in ddsim drops from about 175 s to 104 s single-threaded and from 120 s to 40 s with 8 threads. Peak memory falls by about 2 GB. Per-event cost in 10k-event jobs is essentially unchanged. A reconstruction-level cell-ID bug found during review was fixed before merge.
- **[key4hep/k4geo#682](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/682)** — Fixes the IDEA o2 dual-readout HCAL sensitive-detector action, which encoded endcap cell-ID metadata with the barrel encoding.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#414](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/414)** — The IDEA Delphes card is synced with upstream Delphes, adding photon angular smearing and pointing in the dual-readout calorimeter; the new BeamSpotSmearing module is not included. The EDM4hep output config now writes JetDurhamN2 and GenMissingET and drops ScalarHT. The card requires Delphes ≥ 3.5.2pre02.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#119](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/119)** — GGTFTrackFinder (IDEA tracking) gets a major CPU-time and memory optimisation: The LibTorch dependency is removed by reimplementing the clustering in plain C++. ONNX Runtime graph optimisations are enabled. A new InferenceThreads property makes intra-op threading configurable.
